Then select the unused spare matching the fastest successful trial and deliver it through the ramp into the blue receiving tray.

tasks.objective:
Comparing Phase 1 and Phase 2, did the contents of any comparison box change?

Phase 1: freely inspect comparison locations in a read-only survey of at most 10 decisions. Use mounted cameras, base/torso motion and empty arms; preserve all objects and furniture. Choose DONE or submit PHASE1_COMPLETE when ready; the event occurs unobserved in this same episode. Phase 2: compare with memory and submit ANSWER: <original option>. Then perform the applicable operation: if an object was added, put the actual added object on the collection and inspection tray; if replaced, put the current replacement on the collection and inspection tray; if moved, return the displaced object to its remembered original container/support; if removed, select the matching category and model by appearance from the public spare inventory and replenish the remembered original location; if unchanged, inspect all comparison locations with informative views and leave the contents in place. No grasp is required for no-change. If several locations changed, complete the applicable operation for each change. You may finish Phase 1 before visiting every location; the phase switches automatically after ten decisions. Survey coverage is recorded but is not a transition or full-success gate. The spare tray contains the complete candidate inventory from the beginning in every event variant. Public spare inventory: spare 1 on the stocked spare tray: shaker; spare 2 on the stocked spare tray: jar of cumin; spare 3 on the stocked spare tray: butter; spare 4 on the stocked spare tray: bottle of lavender oil. The spare table is visible and reachable during both phases. Original answer options: ["yes", "no"]
tasks.visual_inspection_notes: Inspected matched phase-one and phase-two top images: the authored added, moved, replaced or compound change is visible; full four-item spare inventory remains unchanged. Native active/inactive actor rendering and geometry synchronization pass.
